source_fit.method: Interval V=R*I_mid + L_air*dI/dt + d(lambda_reaction)/dt. Fit V=R_eff*I_mid+L_eff*dI/dt over the stated steady carrier window. Series C cancels fitted L at the stated frequency; capacitor voltage integrates the actual current from zero initial charge.

discrete_field_energy_check.meaning: Accepted backward-Euler field energy check, not physical inverter input energy. Its numerical loss must decrease under time refinement.

limits: Cold prescribed-current screen, not a circuit solution or switching implementation. Reported maxima are interval-mean voltages, not switch-node peaks.
Check waveform completion, time/grid refinement and energy/numerical losses before using component ratings.
Air L retains round-wire low-frequency/internal-inductance assumptions; AC resistance, proximity, real leads, capacitor ESR/ripple and control dynamics are unresolved.
No droplet or repetition-rate claim follows from electrical compliance.
Cumulative drive work uses interval-mean V and I and ideal energy recovery; DC-bus droop, ESR and switching ripple need a separate supply/capacitor budget.

bus_checks.meaning: Ideal zero supply assistance and zero ESR; uses peak cumulative interval drive work. None means stored bus energy is insufficient.
